profile: SQLite 3.47.2 with the scalar, count, collation and external table profiles in sqlite-grouped-v1.json, sqlite-scalars-v1.json, sqlite-case-v1.json and sqlite-cast-v1.json.

CountComparison.role: The ordered comparison evaluated on the formed group
structure: threshold with integer, NULL or numbered binding role
whether the threshold is on the left
CountComparison.conditions: All types are closed. The owning grouped query checks the count argument against the same input occurrence as counts in the result and checks the threshold as a scalar.
CountComparison.meaning: Evaluate a builtin COUNT over the rows admitted to the group. Compare its INTEGER result with the exact typed threshold, with no implicit column affinity on either operand. The ordered comparison uses the standard SQLite NULL or IS and IS NOT result rules. The group is kept when the result is true.
CountComparison.externalInterpretation: Use the same builtin count, collation registry, declared table and numbered parameter bindings.
CountComparison.sql: Render the count and threshold on the specified sides of the operator after HAVING. Render the count argument by its resolved slot with its effective distinct collation if present.

admission: WHERE admits the closed scalar expression family with the usual expression height and expansion budgets and all column occurrences checked against the sole visible table or the empty scalar scope.

An optional HAVING compares one count of rows, field values, or distinct field values with an integer, NULL, or numbered binding. Either operand can be the count. The count need not appear in the results.
